ourStoryDesc: Kaamkaaz started with a simple goal: to make finding local work as easy as making a phone call.
whatWeDoDesc: We bridge the gap between daily wage workers and those who need their services.
completelyFreeDesc: We do not charge workers any commission or fees. Our platform is free to use.
localFirstDesc: We prioritize connecting you with opportunities in your immediate neighborhood.
ourMissionDesc: To empower every worker with dignified work and every recruiter with reliable help.
about_kaamkaaz_what_is_desc: Kaamkaaz is a free mobile platform that connects daily wage workers (mazdoor) with local employers and recruiters across India. Our goal is to make job searching simple and accessible for every Indian worker regardless of their education level.
about_kaamkaaz_mission_desc: To provide dignified employment opportunities to daily wage workers across India by connecting them directly with genuine local employers — quickly, freely and safely.
about_kaamkaaz_who_can_use_desc:
• Workers: Anyone looking for daily wage, part-time or full-time work in farming, cooking, driving, construction, cleaning, security and more
• Recruiters: Employers, contractors and businesses looking to hire verified local workers
about_kaamkaaz_how_it_works_workers:
For Workers:
1. Register with your phone number
2. Complete your profile and KYC
3. Browse and apply for jobs near you
4. Get hired and earn
about_kaamkaaz_how_it_works_recruiters:
For Recruiters:
1. Register with your phone number
2. Complete KYC verification
3. Post job requirements
4. Review applications and hire workers
about_kaamkaaz_key_features_list:
• Free to use for workers
• OTP based secure login
• KYC verification for safety
• Skill badges for workers
• Recruiter feedback system
• Hindi and English language support
• Job categories: Farming, Cooking, Driving, Construction, Security, Cleaning and more
about_kaamkaaz_contact_hours: Support Hours: Mon–Sat, 9 AM to 6 PM IST
terms_intro: Please read these Terms and Conditions carefully before using the Kaamkaaz mobile application.
terms_section1_desc: By downloading, installing or using the Kaamkaaz app you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these terms please do not use the app. These terms apply to all users including workers and recruiters.
terms_section2_desc:
To use Kaamkaaz you must:
• Be at least 18 years of age
• Have a valid Indian mobile phone number
• Be a resident of India
• Have the legal right to work in India
• Provide accurate and truthful information

Use of the app by anyone under 18 years is strictly prohibited.
terms_section3_desc:
• You must register using your real mobile number
• Only one account is allowed per person
• You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure
• Do not share your account with anyone else
• You must immediately inform us if your account is accessed without your permission
terms_section4_desc: KYC (Know Your Customer) verification is required for full access to the platform. By submitting KYC documents you confirm the documents belong to you and all information provided is accurate. Submitting fake or someone else's documents is a criminal offence under Indian law.
terms_section5_desc: All users must provide accurate profile information, use the platform only for genuine employment purposes, and treat other users with respect and dignity. Illegal activity, harassment, and fake profiles are strictly prohibited.
terms_section6_desc: Recruiters must post only genuine and available job opportunities with accurate details. Discrimination based on caste, religion, gender or disability is strictly prohibited. Recruiters must not collect any money from workers for job placement.
terms_section7_desc: Workers must apply only for jobs they are genuinely interested in, attend work if confirmed, and provide accurate skill and experience information.
terms_section8_desc: Prohibited activities include: creating multiple accounts, posting false jobs, sharing other users' personal info, spamming, scraping data, charging fees for job placement, and attempting to hack the platform.
terms_section9_desc: You have the right to post content that is accurate and legal. We reserve the right to remove any content that violates our guidelines without prior notice.
terms_section10_desc: We may suspend or permanently terminate your account for violating these terms, providing false info, fraudulent activity, or being reported multiple times. Suspended users cannot create new accounts.
terms_section11_desc: Kaamkaaz is a technology platform connecting workers and recruiters. We are NOT an employment agency or employer. We are not responsible for the accuracy of listings, employment disputes, or user conduct.
terms_section12_desc: The Kaamkaaz name, logo and app are our property. You may not copy, reproduce or distribute our content without permission.
terms_section13_desc: Your privacy is important to us. Please read our Privacy Policy to understand how we protect your personal information.
terms_section14_desc: We may update these Terms at any time. Continued use of the app after changes means you accept the new terms.
terms_section15_desc: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Any disputes will be subject to the jurisdiction of courts in India.
terms_section16_desc: For any questions about these Terms: support@kaamkaaz.com. Support Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM IST
privacy_intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Kaamkaaz collects, uses, stores and protects your personal information. By using our app you consent to the practices described in this policy.
privacy_section1_desc: We collect information you provide (name, phone, photo, skills, KYC docs) and information collected automatically (device info, usage data, location). We do NOT collect Aadhaar numbers in plain text, bank details, or private phone contacts.
privacy_section2_desc: We use your data for account management, KYC identity verification, job matching, recruiter reviews, and platform safety. We will NEVER sell your information or use it for third-party marketing.
privacy_section3_desc: Aadhaar photos are collected ONLY for KYC. Numbers are never stored in plain text and data is encrypted. We comply fully with UIDAI guidelines for handling Aadhaar data.
privacy_section4_desc: Data is shared only with other users (for job applications), secure service partners (Firebase), or as required by Indian law. We never sell your personal data.
privacy_section5_desc: All data is stored on encrypted Google Cloud servers using industry-standard security practices. Access is restricted to authorised personnel only.
privacy_section6_desc: Account data is kept while active. KYC documents are deleted after verification. If you delete your account, all data is permanently erased within 30 days.
privacy_section7_desc: Under the DPDP Act 2023, you have the right to access, correct, or erase your data, and appoint a nominee. Contact us at privacy@kaamkaaz.com for requests.
privacy_section8_desc: Kaamkaaz is not intended for anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from minors.
privacy_section9_desc: We collect approximate location (city/area) for job matching only. We do not track your real-time location.
privacy_section10_desc: We send alerts for new jobs, application updates, and KYC status. You can disable these in your phone settings.
privacy_section11_desc: We are not responsible for the privacy practices of external websites linked within our app.
privacy_section12_desc: We may update this policy at any time. Continued use of the app after changes means you accept the updated policy.
privacy_section13_desc: As per IT Act 2000 and DPDP Act 2023, our Grievance Officer can be reached at privacy@kaamkaaz.com. Response time: Within 30 days.
privacy_section14_desc: For privacy related questions: privacy@kaamkaaz.com. Support Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM IST
faq_q1: How do I create an account?
faq_a1: Download the app, enter your mobile number, verify with OTP and fill in your basic details. Registration is completely free.
faq_a2: Go to Profile → KYC Verification. Upload a clear photo of your Aadhaar card (front and back) and take a live selfie. KYC is verified within 24 to 48 hours.
faq_a3: Yes. Kaamkaaz is completely free for workers. There are no charges for creating an account, browsing jobs or applying for jobs.
faq_q4: How do I apply for a job?
faq_a4: Browse jobs on the home or search screen. Tap on a job to see details and tap Apply. The recruiter will contact you if selected.
faq_a5: Recruiters may reject applications for various reasons such as the position being filled or skills not matching. Keep your profile updated with accurate skills for better chances.
faq_q6: How do I change the app language?
faq_a6: On the login screen tap the language selector at the top right. You can choose between English and Hindi.
faq_q7: How do I delete my account?
faq_a7: Go to Profile → Edit Profile → scroll to the bottom and tap Delete Account. All your data will be permanently deleted within 30 days.
faq_q8: My OTP is not coming. What should I do?
faq_a8: Check your network connection. Wait 60 seconds and tap Resend OTP. If still not received contact support at support@kaamkaaz.com
faq_rq1: How do I post a job?
faq_ra1: Complete your KYC first. Then tap the Post Job button on the home screen and fill in the job details.
faq_rq2: Is company name required for KYC?
faq_ra2: No. Company name and work details are optional for recruiters. Only Aadhaar card and live selfie are mandatory for all users.
faq_rq3: Why is my account pending verification?
faq_ra3: Your KYC documents are being reviewed. This takes 24 to 48 hours. You will receive a notification once verified.
faq_ra4: Accounts are suspended for violating our Terms and Conditions such as posting fake jobs or fraudulent activity. Contact support if you believe this was a mistake.
faq_rq5: Can I hire workers without completing KYC?
faq_ra5: No. KYC verification is mandatory for all users including recruiters before posting jobs.
